prompt:
A sprite sheet of 7 separate objects for a top-down JRPG map, to be placed on top of the painted map shown in the reference image. Match the reference exactly: the same hi-bit pixel-painting style and brushwork, the same palette and material textures, the same soft light from the upper left (lit tops and left sides, shaded right sides), the same classic steep 3/4 top-down view (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 4 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom) with wide empty space between them; every object fully separate, nothing touching, nothing cut off. Draw each object large, filling most of its grid cell. The objects, in order: 1) small cluster of pale teal glowing mushrooms; 2) cluster of pale green-blue crystals growing from mossy rock; 3) small old iron lantern standing on the ground (unlit); 4) mossy tree stump; 5) fallen mossy log lying on the ground; 6) small mossy stone; 7) rustic wooden signpost with a blank plank.
Background: fully transparent. No ground, no floor, no shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers. Even albedo lighting: no night, no glow halos and no light spilling around the objects (lamps unlit).
revised_prompt: Create an image: a game-ready sprite sheet of EXACTLY SEVEN isolated objects, closely matching the attached reference forest map's hi-bit pixel-painting aesthetic: finely dithered/painterly pixel brushwork, muted deep olive/moss greens, weathered earthy browns, dark blue-green foliage, subdued pale teal accents, natural textured surfaces. Classic steep 3/4 top-down JRPG view: visible top planes and front faces, upright objects based at bottom, soft upper-left illumination (tops and left sides lighter, right sides shaded). CANVAS: fully transparent alpha background, no colored backdrop. Layout as a spacious 2 COLUMN x 4 ROW grid, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom, with each sprite large within its own cell and plenty of clear transparent padding so no silhouettes overlap or clip. Row 1: left a small grouping of pale teal luminous-looking mushroom caps on stems (bright caps but NO aura or emitted spill); right pale green-blue faceted crystals emerging from a compact mossy rock. Row 2: left small antique ground-standing iron lantern, extinguished, dark glass, NO flame; right weathered tree stump, moss along top and bark. Row 3: left a moss-covered fallen log oriented horizontally, its end grain visible; right one small irregular mossy stone. Row 4: left rustic timber signpost, ONE blank horizontal wooden plank, no markings; right cell intentionally EMPTY. Carefully emulate reference map's pixel size, material texture, palette, and soft albedo light; objects should blend seamlessly when placed onto the attached forest map. Absolutely NO terrain, ground, cast shadows, floor, glowing halos, light spill, text, lettering, numbers, labels, borders, cell outlines, or extra objects.
